newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fixes at highest in over two year.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fixes at highest in over two year.

text.p: Palladium fixed at its highest level in over two years on Friday afternoon when it was set at $164.50 per ounce, up from $162.50 in the morning.
It was the rare white metal's highest fixing since April 24, 1995.
Palladium's sister metal platinum fixed at $383.50, its highest setting since March 5, 1997.

Prices of both metals have risen rapidly this year since Russia, the leading exporter of palladium and second biggest exporter of platinum, and Japan the largest importer of both, have failed to agree terms for their 1997 supply contract.
"The market is so tight it is too expensive to borrow palladium so dealers are buying spot metal which is what is pushing the price up," a dealer said.
A Russian official said earlier this week he expected talks with Japanese importers to begin soon.
